lane: SQL + Edge + Admin: Thành viên & quyền (Owner invites or adds admin accounts and picks a role with a plain list of what it allows)
goal: Owner request 14/11: an Owner account can invite or add other admin accounts and, while doing so, see the admin type and the permissions that come with it. Adds an Admin page Thành viên & quyền (roles.manage) with the member list, a Mời thành viên dialog whose can / cannot list is generated from one server-side role-to-capability map, change-role and revoke with confirmation; a migration that makes has_capability read that single map and adds list / set / revoke / matrix RPCs plus service-role-only invite RPCs with a per-owner daily cap and audit rows; and an Edge Function admin-team-invite that checks roles.manage with the caller's session, then invites a new email with the service role (or only assigns the role to an existing account). The role map itself is unchanged. Nothing is applied or deployed by the agent; the Owner's own owner row is never touched.
successCriteria: Migration 20261114090000_admin_team_roles.sql moves the role-to-capability CASE map into nilaza_private.roles_have_capability(roles, capability) and redefines nilaza_private.has_capability(capability) to call it with current_roles(), so every existing policy and RPC keeps the exact same answers; the capability list lives in nilaza_private.admin_capability_list() and get_admin_access uses it.

list_admin_team (roles.manage) returns each member with email, active roles, every assignment with status and date, account created / invited / confirmed / last sign-in times, isMe, and today's invite count and daily cap; never a token, password hash or metadata.

set_admin_member_role and revoke_admin_member (roles.manage) refuse self changes (NZT01), refuse removing or demoting the last active owner (NZT02), require confirm_owner=true to grant owner (NZT03), only touch existing members (NZT04), keep exactly one active role per member after a change, and write role.set / role.revoke audit rows naming the actor, target user, role and previous roles.
get_admin_role_matrix (roles.manage) returns every role with the capabilities nilaza_private.roles_have_capability grants it, so the Admin can / cannot list cannot drift from the database.

admin_team_invite_begin / admin_team_invite_finish are service_role only, re-check that the actor is an active owner from the database, validate email and role, never change the actor's own roles, return already_member for an account that already has an active role, count only invites that send an email against a per-owner cap of 10 per Vietnam day (NZT05), refuse an existing account whose email was never confirmed unless an Admin invite created it (NZT06), and audit role.invite.

Edge Function admin-team-invite (POST, verify_jwt true) checks roles.manage with the caller's session, validates email and role, calls the begin RPC, invites with auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail only when the account does not exist and ADMIN_INVITE_REDIRECT_URL is a valid https URL, assigns the role with the finish RPC, and never returns or logs the invite link, token, email or secrets.

Admin: Thành viên & quyền in the Vận hành group (next to Lịch sử thao tác, spec 04/11 §3.15 pairs the permission table with Audit), Vietnamese text, escaped values, missing RPC names the migration and missing function names the deploy; recovery.html also accepts invite links so an invited person can set a password.

PGlite verification of the migration, Deno tests for the pure invite parts, jsdom admin tests in admin:test, validate-admin-contract, validate:backend, supabase:check and preflight --ci pass (known Windows CRLF-only failure excepted).
untouchedSurfaces: The role map (which role gets which capability) is unchanged: admin keeps ai.manage and content.publish; changing it is an Owner decision.
The Owner's own owner assignment and every existing admin_role_assignments row are not modified by the migration; the guard and audit triggers from 20260902131408 stay in place.
Mobile app, AI functions, content workspace, AI Studio modules and the Growth workspace are unchanged.
No account is created, no migration applied, no function deployed, no secret or Auth setting changed; PLAN.md and the backlog file are left to the coordinator.

impact.entryPoint: Admin left navigation Vận hành › Thành viên & quyền (new workspace team.html, route members, roles.manage); Edge Function admin-team-invite; recovery.html for the invite link landing page.
impact.dataWrite: admin_role_assignments rows (insert or status change) through definer RPCs; admin_audit_logs rows role.set, role.revoke, role.invite (plus the existing trigger rows role.insert / role.update); new private table nilaza_private.admin_team_invite_days (actor, Vietnam day, count); Supabase Auth creates the invited auth.users row.
impact.backendContract: RPCs list_admin_team(), set_admin_member_role(uuid, text, boolean), revoke_admin_member(uuid), get_admin_role_matrix() for authenticated callers with roles.manage; admin_team_invite_begin(uuid, text, text, boolean, boolean) and admin_team_invite_finish(uuid, uuid, text, boolean) for service_role only; POST /functions/v1/admin-team-invite {email, role, confirmOwner} -> {status: assigned | already_member | invited, role, userId, roles?, invitesToday?, inviteDailyCap?} or {error: invalid_request | invalid_email | invalid_role | owner_confirm_required | not_authorized | self_change | last_owner | member_not_found | invite_limit | invite_not_configured | migration_missing | invite_failed}.
impact.adminVisibility: Owner sees every member's email, roles, status, created / invited / last sign-in dates and today's invite count; role changes appear in Lịch sử thao tác (role.* rows are already limited to roles.manage). Other roles do not see the page or its RPCs.
impact.privacySafety: Only staff accounts (rows in admin_role_assignments) are listed; no tokens, password hashes, user metadata or app data; the invite link is never returned or logged; the email is not written to audit rows or function logs; capabilities stay live (no JWT cache) so a revoke takes effect on the next request.
impact.observability: Audit rows role.set / role.revoke / role.invite with actor, target, role, previous roles and invited yes/no; the function returns fixed error codes; Supabase Auth logs the invite email delivery.
impact.rollback: Revoking a member restores the previous access level; the migration only redefines has_capability with the same answers, so re-running the old CASE body restores it; the page and function are additive and can be removed from the navigation; without the migration the page names the migration and without the function deploy the dialog names the function.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Record and preflight before the first edit; migration and deploy left to the Owner by hash; account creation (an invite) is an Owner action on staging; PGlite, Deno and jsdom tests only.

dependencyReview.evidence: auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail(email, { redirectTo, data }) from @supabase/supabase-js (the functions pin esm.sh @supabase/supabase-js@2.7.1, whose GoTrueAdminApi already has it) returns { data: { user }, error } and must only run on a server with the service role; redirectTo must match the Auth Redirect URLs list. Checked against the current Supabase docs and auth-js source on 2026-11-14. No repository dependency added; PGlite only in the session scratchpad.

externalSourceReview.reason: Method exists: sends an invite link to an email address; params email and options.
Signature inviteUserByEmail(email, { data?, redirectTo? }) -> UserResponse; auth errors resolve as { data: { user: null }, error }; admin methods are server only with the service_role key.
redirectTo should match the Redirect URLs list; Site URL is the default when no redirectTo is given.

securityReview.authzRls: All member RPCs are security definer with search_path '' and check auth.uid() plus has_capability('roles.manage') (owner only); invite begin/finish are granted to service_role only and re-check from admin_role_assignments that the actor is an active owner; everything is revoked from public and anon. The new private table has no client grants. has_capability keeps its signature, invoker rights and answers, now reading the single map.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only staff accounts are listed, with email and auth timestamps for the Owner; no tokens, password hashes, user metadata or app content. Audit rows carry user ids and roles, not emails.
securityReview.secretsLogging: The function never logs or returns the service key, the invite link, the email or Auth error text; the redirect URL comes from the ADMIN_INVITE_REDIRECT_URL env var whose value is not read by the agent.
securityReview.externalInput: Email trimmed, lowercased and checked (length 3-254, one @, a dot in the domain, no spaces or control characters) in both the function and SQL; role from a fixed list; owner needs an explicit confirmation flag; Admin escapes every value.
securityReview.dependencies: No package added; the function reuses the esm.sh supabase-js and std versions already pinned by other admin functions.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Owner applies 20261114090000_admin_team_roles.sql by hash, adds the Admin recovery URL to Auth Redirect URLs, sets ADMIN_INVITE_REDIRECT_URL and deploys admin-team-invite; until then the page names what is missing. Re-running has_capability's change is idempotent (create or replace).
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if PGlite shows any capability answer differs from the old map, if any path lets a caller change their own roles or remove the last owner, if the function could return or log the invite link or a secret, or if any test fails.

managerTestPath: After the Owner applies the migration, sets ADMIN_INVITE_REDIRECT_URL to the Admin recovery page (also listed in Auth Redirect URLs) and deploys admin-team-invite: open Admin › Vận hành › Thành viên & quyền, see yourself marked (bạn) with no change buttons; press Mời thành viên, type a test email, pick Biên tập viên and read the can / cannot list, pick Owner and see the extra warning and confirmation box; invite as Biên tập viên; the new member appears as Đã mời, chưa đăng nhập; open the email, set a password on the recovery page, sign in and see only the editor pages; as Owner change the role, then revoke it, confirming each; see each step in Lịch sử thao tác.
residualRisk: PGlite is not Supabase: auth.users is stubbed (email, invited_at, last_sign_in_at...) and the real Auth invite email, redirect and rate limits are not exercised; re-run the Security Advisor after applying. Trigger audit rows written during a service-role invite have no actor (the explicit role.invite row names the Owner). An existing account is assigned the role without a new email only when its email is confirmed or it was created by an Admin invite (NZT06 otherwise); if the project has Auth email confirmation switched off, Auth marks every sign-up confirmed, so the Owner should keep Confirm email on and invite only addresses they trust. Every role write re-checks the actor after taking the lock, so an owner demoted by a concurrent change cannot finish an in-flight one. If the Auth invite call fails after the daily counter was taken, that slot is not refunded (conservative). The Admin page loads supabase-js from the CDN without SRI, like the other Admin pages. The admin role keeps ai.manage and content.publish (Owner decision).
